enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes steadily. Occasional turning. Continues sleeping.

Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Opens bathroom door. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Turns on sink tap. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Shampoos hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body with towel. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Wipes mouth with towel. Applies deodorant. Opens closet. Picks out clothes. Puts on underwear. Puts on pants. Puts on shirt. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Looks in mirror. Adjusts hair.

Walks to kitchen. Enters kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out eggs. Takes out butter. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl. Takes out plate. Takes out glass. Closes cabinet. Opens drawer. Takes out fork. Takes out knife. Closes drawer. Opens bread box. Takes out bread. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever down. Opens cupboard. Takes out cereal. Pours cereal into bowl. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Pours milk into bowl. Closes refrigerator. Opens microwave. Places bowl in microwave. Closes microwave door. Presses start button. Opens refrigerator. Takes out orange juice. Pours juice into glass. Closes refrigerator. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Flips eggs with spatula. Turns off induction cooker. Slides eggs onto plate. Takes toast from toaster. Places toast on plate. Carries plate to table. Carries bowl to table. Carries glass to table. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Picks up knife. Cuts eggs. Eats eggs. Eats cereal. Drinks juice. Wipes mouth with napkin. Stands up. Carries dishes to sink. Turns on tap. Rinses dishes. Turns off tap. Opens dishwasher. Places dishes in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Wipes counter with sponge. Turns off kitchen light.

Walks to bedroom. Enters bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Opens closet. Picks out work clothes. Takes off casual clothes. Puts on work shirt. Puts on work pants. Puts on belt. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Stands in front of mirror. Adjusts shirt. Combs hair. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up wallet. Puts wallet in pocket. Picks up keys. Puts keys in pocket. Picks up bag. Opens bag. Places laptop in bag. Closes bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Turns off bedroom light. Turns off fan. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of house. Closes door. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks watch. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Listens to music on phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to bus door. Steps off bus. Walks to office building. Opens building door. Walks to elevator. Presses elevator button. Waits for elevator. Elevator arrives. Steps into elevator. Presses floor button. Elevator stops. Steps out of elevator. Walks to office door. Opens office door. Enters office.

Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Answers phone. Speaks on phone. Hangs up. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Picks up notebook. Walks to meeting room. Sits in meeting. Listens to speaker. Takes notes. Asks question. Stands up. Walks back to desk. Sits at desk. Opens document. Types report. Saves document. Prints document. Walks to printer. Picks up document. Walks back to desk. Places document on desk. Picks up phone. Makes call. Speaks on phone. Hangs up. Opens spreadsheet. Enters data. Saves spreadsheet. Closes computer. Stands up. Walks to break room. Pours coffee. Walks back to desk. Sits at desk. Drinks coffee. Opens computer. Continues working.

Stands up from desk. Walks to break room. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch bag. Closes refrigerator. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Takes out apple. Takes out water bottle. Sits at table. Opens water bottle. Drinks water. Eats sandwich. Eats apple. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Closes lunch bag. Stands up. Walks to microwave. Opens microwave. Places food container in microwave. Closes microwave. Presses start button. Microwave beeps. Opens microwave. Takes out container. Closes microwave. Walks back to table. Sits at table. Eats food. Finishes eating. Cleans up. Walks outside. Walks around building. Returns to office. Sits at desk.

Opens computer. Checks emails. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens project plan. Reviews plan. Edits plan. Saves plan. Picks up phone. Calls community partner. Discusses event details. Hangs up. Writes notes. Opens calendar. Schedules meeting. Sends meeting invite. Stands up. Walks to colleague's desk. Discusses project. Returns to desk. Sits at desk. Opens document. Writes proposal. Saves proposal. Prints proposal. Walks to printer. Picks up proposal. Walks back to desk. Places proposal on desk. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Opens spreadsheet. Updates budget. Saves spreadsheet. Closes computer. Stands up. Stretches. Walks to water cooler. Fills cup with water. Drinks water. Walks back to desk. Sits at desk. Opens computer. Continues working.

Stands up from desk. Picks up bag. Walks to office door. Opens office door. Walks to elevator. Presses elevator button. Waits for elevator. Elevator arrives. Steps into elevator. Presses floor button. Elevator stops. Steps out of elevator. Walks to building exit. Opens building door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks watch. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Listens to music on phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to bus door. Steps off bus. Walks to house. Opens door. Enters house. Closes door. Locks door.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken. Takes out vegetables. Takes out sauce. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out pot. Takes out pan. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Closes cabinet. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Pours water into pot. Adds salt. Cuts vegetables on cutting board. Places vegetables in pot. Cuts chicken on cutting board. Places chicken in pan. Turns on stove. Cooks chicken. Stirs pot. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Carries plate to table. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Finishes eating. Stands up. Carries plate to sink. Turns on tap. Rinses plate. Turns off tap. Opens dishwasher. Places plate in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Wipes counter. Turns off kitchen light.

Walks to living room. Turns on living room light. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks social media. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch. Eats snack. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Stands up. Turns off living room light.

Sits on couch. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Continues reading. Adjusts lamp. Reads more pages. Closes book. Puts book on table. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Pours glass of water. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up book. Opens book. Continues reading. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book on table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Undresses. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Shampoos hair. Conditions hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Wipes mouth. Applies moisturizer. Applies deodorant. Puts on pajamas. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out.

Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Changes into pajamas. Turns on fan. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Scrolls through phone. Watches videos. Puts down phone. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off bedroom light. Lies down. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket. Turns to side. Sleeps.
